items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: And I played a couple of things with him. I played on a mass that he wrote, a recording, I played actually Fender bass on that. And there was a ballet piece he wrote called “Dybbuk” that I played on. And we did “Symphony of Psalms” at Carnegie Hall one time that he conducted.

ctx.x: Bassist John Beal is the very definition of a versatile working musician. He has spent seven decades playing onstage and in studios with the likes of Kenny Davern, Harry Belafonte and Leonard Bernstein.
John was interviewed via Zoom on June 18, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
